name: Multigrain+ Corn Flakes
ingredients_raw: MULTIGRAIN MIX (82.6%) {CORN GRITS & CORN MEAL (26.2%), WHEAT & WHEAT FLOUR (ATTA) (21.8%), RICE & RICE FLOUR (15%), RAGI FLOUR (13.1%), ROLLED BARLEY (6.5%)}, SUGAR, CEREAL EXTRACT, OLIGOFRUCTOSE, WHEAT BRAN, IODIZED SALT, COCOA SOLIDS, VITAMINS, FLAVOURS {NATURE IDENTICAL & ARTIFICIAL (COCONUT)}, ANTIOXIDANT (INS 307b), COLOUR (INS 150d) AND MINERAL.
